Do not, I repeat, DO NOT let them keep your pet over night. While on a family trip a relative of mine entrusted this facility with her beloved dog. While on the trip they said he was doing great. When she picked him up he began to throw up that day. He died 4 days later. After wards they mentioned that he had diarrhea while in their care,  which wasn’t mentioned previously. When she dropped the dog off he was perfectly fine, no issues what so ever. He went from perfectly fine to dead a few days after being in their care. This is very unfortunate and heart breaking!!

Wish I could give this place 0 stars!!!  Dog became severely sick after being here for a week! Staff did not update about his illness, despite multiple attempts to check on him. Tried to blame grooming on the fact that he was sick. Ultimately , he passed away shortly after boarding here. Staff has not shown much remorse. Soooo heartbreaking that my family is broken and incomplete now.

Do NOT board your dog here. I was fooled by the reviews but now I see they’re more so related to grooming not boarding. I dropped my Yorkiepoo off on 08/02 and picked him up on 08/10. I reached out several times and asked how he was doing and was told “ oh he’s doing great “. When I picked him up he was throwing up in the Uber on the way home. Since last Sunday he has continued to throw up black stuff. He is not been himself and hasn’t pooped or eaten. The smell on his breath is horrendous! I figured it out he was eating poop. In the over 8yrs I’ve had my baby he has never done such. When they gave me his bag of food it looked like they hadn’t been feeding him so maybe that’s why.  I called and was told “oh he had diarrhea for a few days” which wasn’t told to me when I was checking in. The owner still hasn’t reached out supposedly because he’s on vacation but do not patronize this place. My little baby is still not doing good and it’s been a week since he’s been back home. As I post this update with tears in my eyes, on August 20th Jax passed away. For you to try to mention his nails like that had something to do with and even say “you have proof “ like that caused him to get sick at your establishment is a disgrace. I had Jax for NINE years and he’s NEVER been sick the way I seen him when I got him back from this kennel. Makes me wonder about the inside conditions customers don’t see.  I will continue to spread the word about this foul business because after 9yrs my baby is now dead because of Petz mania!!!

I took my two small dogs in for teeth brushing ($13 each), and the experience was very concerning. The staff member took my first dog to the back and returned in about 2 seconds, claiming it was done. That’s impossible, especially since my dogs don’t allow people near their mouths easily.

When I asked what she used, she said toothpaste, foam, and a toothbrush—but there’s no way a proper brushing was done that fast. I even saw her spray foam in my second dog’s mouth and then immediately return saying it was complete.

When I questioned this, she said, “Because they love me.” That was not professional or believable. Thankfully, I wasn’t charged, but I will be checking.

Pet owners, please be cautious and ask questions. This experience left me with zero confidence in the service.
